fig.suptitle('Comprehensive Titanic Survival Analysis', fontsize=22, weight='bold')

axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Density', fontsize=12)

legend.get_texts()[0].set_text('No')

legend.get_texts()[0].set_text('No')
legend.get_texts()[1].set_text('Yes')

sns.swarmplot(x='survived', y='fare', data=df, ax=axes[1, 1], color='k', alpha=0.3, size=3)
